profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2009. According to its website, the firm invests in bold founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology, operating under the motto "Software Is Eating the World."

The company has significant legal exposure in California, with 220 cases on record in the state. No AI products, MCP servers, or SEC filings are currently tracked for the firm in this database.
